summary: Specifies mechanisms for backward compatibility between Ethernet VPN (EVPN) and PBB-EVPN and the older VPLS and PBB-VPLS solutions. It also describes how both technologies can coexist in the same MPLS/IP network, per VPN instance, so providers can introduce EVPN gradually. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: A company adopting a new phone system can run it alongside the old one while employees move over gradually. This document explains how the old and new network services can work together.
